newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-GRIQUAS TO CHASE 396 ON FINAL DAY VS EP.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-GRIQUAS TO CHASE 396 ON FINAL DAY VS EP.

text.p: Needing a massive target of 396 to win, Griqualand West face a long battle for survival on the final day of their Supersport series cricket match against Eastern Province at St George's Park on Monday.
At the close of play on Sunday the visitors had lost three key batsmen in taking their total to 104 in 47 overs.
Earlier E.P. had taken a first innings lead of 210 when they dismissed Griquas for 266. West Indian Eldine Baptiste taking five wickets in an innings for the 30th time in his career.
Skipper Kepler Wessels decided not to enforce the follow-on and E.P. took full advantage of a demoralised Griquas team to rattle up 185 for three declared.

Griquas showed some spirit in holding the home side's attack at bay for long periods in the final session but will need to display alot more of that, as well as infinite patience if they are to force a draw on Monday.
Eastern Province first innings 476 for 6 declared (Louis Keon 186, Dave Callaghan 102, Mark Rushmere 63)
Bowling: Hayward 21-3-76-2, Ferreria 12-3-41-2, Baptiste 25.3-2-60-5, Shaw 29-12-27-1, Love 19-4-51-0
Total (for three wickets in 42 overs declared) 185
Bowling: Hayward 11-1-41-0, Ferreira 4-1-8-0, Baptiste 9-3-15-0, Shaw 14-7-22-2, Love 9-4-11-1.
Bonus points: Eastern Province 9, Griqualand West 4.
